title: Patient-derived organoids in advanced thyroid carcinoma as a platform for precision oncology
summary:
Science is making great progress in researching and combating diseases. Much of this research initially takes place in the laboratory. An important platform for laboratory research is provided by so-called organoids: three-dimensional structures made up of various cell types from a specific organ or tumor, which together form a structure similar to that of the original organ or tumor.

The aim of this study is to generate such organoids from the tumor tissue of patients with thyroid carcinoma. The organoids obtained in this way will then be used to better understand and further investigate thyroid carcinoma.

interventions.name: Establishment of a 3D organoid biobank from thyroid carcinoma tissue and corresponding normal tissue.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Written informed consent
- Histopathologically confirmed thyroid carcinoma
- Evidence of lymph node and/or distant metastases
Exclusion criteria:
- Age < 18 years
- Lack of capacity to consent
- Insufficient tumor tissue available for organoid establishment
- Pregnancy
